description: Create a persistent Jumio end-user account. An account groups all workflow executions (KYC transactions) for the same real-world user, enabling re-use of previously verified data and longitudinal fraud signals.

callbackUrl.description: HTTPS callback URL for Jumio to POST workflow results to.

customerInternalReference.description: Your internal user id. Stored on the Jumio account and echoed back on webhooks.

userReference.description: Opaque reference shown to the user in the Jumio flow (e.g. masked email).

workflowDefinition.description: Optional: an inline workflow definition to run immediately on account creation. Usually you omit this and call initiate_transaction separately.

key.description: Numeric workflow key from the Jumio portal (e.g. 200 for ID+selfie).

name: initiate_account
